No new clipping, jagged alpha artifact, missing rice/plate edge, body seam, flicker or unintended native change. Playback timing and loops match the approved body.

sourceCaveatsAndAcceptedDifferences: Source packed image is square 1254 with UV crop and low-alpha specks/margins; the new exact 731x505 full-UV quad has a different top/corner rectangle. The measured alpha 128 support and display width, rather than the old quad rectangle, are the source anchors.
Canonical alpha occupied width/height and radiance naturally differ from old food under the unchanged native shader. This permits no extra crop, pixel processing, grade or body material/light edit.
Source hold/load 2D plate is high near face/chest and N can be hidden. Actual source motion extends and returns retaining the dish. No native 3D food or new belt release is required or claimed.

A source control pair showed 10 pixels with 1-level RGB differences and identical alpha under the same recorded settings; do not mistake small repeat-render variability for unauthorized body data edits, or use it to excuse native changes or substantial visible defects.
